integrity: The exact proof reduces the norm quotient to a two-phase fourth-moment formula and then to a one-variable rational maximum. Exact polynomial identities and a direct Fourier replay are supplied; numerical sampling is used only as a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to real zero-mean functions on the order-five cyclic group with the stated sign multiplier. It does not determine complex-input norms, other cyclic orders, or a general monotonicity law.
title: Exact fourth-power norm of the order-five cyclic Hilbert transform
